user.title: Connect to T3 Code Monitor
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should connect to the T3 Code environment.

direct.title: Connect directly to T3 Code
direct.description: Enter the environment API base URL, not the T3 web app URL or a /pair page, and a one-time pairing credential. {diagnostic}

connect.title: Authorize T3 Connect
connect.description: Open {verification_uri} and enter code {user_code}. After approving T3 Code Monitor, submit to continue.

data.authorized: I approved access in my browser

connect_environment.title: Choose T3 Code environments
connect_environment.description: Select one or more environments already linked to your T3 Connect account. Home Assistant will ask for a one-time pairing credential for each selected environment.

connect_pairing.title: Pair T3 Code environment
connect_pairing.description: Create a one-time pairing credential on {environment_name}, then enter it below. The discovered environment URL is {environment_url}.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS base URL.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the T3 Code environment. Check the URL and network access.
error.no_environments: No T3 Code environments are linked to this T3 Connect account.
error.invalid_pairing_credential: The pairing credential was rejected, expired, or could not be exchanged for orchestration:read. Create a new pairing credential and try again.

abort.already_configured: This T3 Code environment is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not complete T3 Connect. Check the Home Assistant logs for a safe diagnostic.
abort.no_environments: No T3 Code environments are linked to this T3 Connect account.

init.title: Renew T3 Code Monitor connection
init.description: Direct connections: enter a fresh one-time pairing credential. T3 Connect connections: submit to renew using the saved account authorization. {diagnostic}

error.invalid_pairing_credential: The pairing credential was rejected, expired, or could not be exchanged for orchestration:read. Create a new pairing credential and try again.
error.renewal_failed: Could not renew the T3 Connect session. Check the Home Assistant logs for a safe diagnostic.
